tools.name: token_report
tools.description: Safety and market report for one Solana token: price, liquidity, holders, mint/freeze authority, risk score and flags. Paid via x402: a few free calls per day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call on Solana. When payment is required the result has isError=true and the x402 PaymentRequired object in s

tools.name: token_report_batch
tools.description: Reports for 1-50 Solana mints in one call. Paid via x402 (0.01 USDC per call after the free tier), same payment flow as token_report.

tools.name: token_search
tools.description: Search Solana tokens by name, symbol or mint. Free. Returns mint, symbol, decimals, verified flag, price and liquidity.

tools.name: solana_swap_quote
tools.description: Indicative Jupiter quote with Lantern's 1.00% app fee already included and disclosed in the 'fee' field. No wallet needed. Free.

tools.name: solana_swap_build
tools.description: Builds an unsigned Jupiter swap transaction (base64) for the taker's PUBLIC address, including Lantern's 1.00% app fee (see feeDisclosure). Lantern never signs or holds keys: sign it with the agent's own wallet, then broadcast it yourself or with solana_send_transaction. Sanctioned addresses are ref

tools.name: solana_send_transaction
tools.description: Broadcasts a transaction that solana_swap_build produced in the last few minutes and the taker's wallet signed. Anything Lantern did not build is refused. Free.

tools.name: solana_tx_status
tools.description: Confirmation status for a Solana transaction signature. Free.

tools.name: base_swap_quote
tools.description: Base (EVM) swap via 0x with the app fee included. Returns status 'coming_soon' while Base trading is switched off. With a taker it returns a firm quote with an UNSIGNED transaction for the agent's own wallet.

tools.name: polymarket_markets
tools.description: Trending Polymarket markets (no query) or search results. Only markets currently accepting orders. Read-only market data. Free.

tools.name: polymarket_market
tools.description: One Polymarket market by slug: question, outcomes, prices, volume, end date. Read-only. Free.
